structured.answer: I'd open an account at Pesagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) and buy the ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) fund (5139282) with a 0.02% fee. The page says about 86,500 ₪ after 10 years, but that's for its default 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 a month (70,000 ₪ put in), not my own amount.

stuck.why: They show 10,000/500, not my 30,000; I couldn't change them, so the result isn't really my number
Too many similar funds with tags I don't understand and red minus numbers; I'd only pick because the page had one preselected as cheapest
Charts and tables full of minus percentages about נטרול מט"ח; got bored and stopped here

findings.what: The default amounts (10,000 + 500/month) aren't mine, and the big result number sticks even though it doesn't fit my situation
Far too many near-identical funds; without the preselected 'הזול' I'd have given up
Jargon tags (עסקת החלף, צוברת, נטרול מט"ח) with no plain explanation
Red minus shekel figures and ranges like 'בין +2,212 ל-−23,766' are scary and unclear
Currency hedging section is long and technical; this is where I'd close the page
Fund fee shown only as 0.02%, not in shekels
'−43 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם' is unclear about whether it's worse or better
